subject: general
question:
In the given letter-cluster pairs, the first letter-cluster is related to the second letter-cluster following a certain logic. Study the given pairs carefully, and from the given options, select the pair that follows the same logic.

YRF : UNB

GLS : CHO
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

YRF : UNB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8570bf3348b775890a017f02a9ea76ce3426f2026afbf118f6bc0b8628d70378.png] 

And,

GLS : CHO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08f050865393b46bc3d37b81cafe42b85026ef38fab7f27cbbdc1b7dbdadd7e9.png] 

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) TDU : GWF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce5b9f690c41e6b94977e24f0acdd28a713fa28e76bbf275a44534b1acc67da6.png] 

Option 2) RJM : TSY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/238d696e9a1e029be92cb6c12996bee07c13d91316e77b5858926f869c693aa1.png] 

Option 3) MPL : ILH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a8fc63849f979dbcaac6b7bdc6540a8f5f661319e4c180abdf9c46b1ae0efc1.png] 

Option 4) OKA : LPZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f58240fd23f817febd894c9d763abce5c7a40d25d2c655c8fffed4f7292311b.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'MPL : ILH' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
